items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Re Enters Obesity Drugs With Metsera Acquisition
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) has closed its acquisition of Metsera, marking a re-entry into the obesity drug market focused on injectables. The deal gives Pfizer control of Metsera's portfolio of long-acting obesity drug candidates targeting chronic weight management. Management plans to use Metsera's long-acting injectable programs to compete in the crowded anti obesity drug segment.
